name: accad
description: ACCAD Open Motion Project BVH (The Ohio State University; Female1, Male1, Male2): 22-joint MotionBuilder-named skeleton (Hips, ToSpine, Spine, Spine1, Neck, Head, L/R Shoulder, Arm, ForeArm, Hand, UpLeg, Leg, Foot, ToeBase), 30 fps, cm units, bind pose is a T-pose.
licence: CC BY 3.0 Unported: credit 'Motion capture data from the ACCAD Open Motion Project, The Ohio State University (accad.osu.edu), licensed under CC BY 3.0; retargeted and edited.'
notes: No fingers: relaxed hand pose applied. Neck sits 27 cm above Spine1 (the shoulders branch from Spine1), so upper_chest's rest direction is Spine1->Neck. Takes do not start in a T-pose: use the bind pose (rest_frame 'bind'). Hand end sites are unmapped. Male1/Male2 BVH bind poses are NOT T-poses (MotionBuilder offsets with the upper spine along +X, differing per take): use rest_frame 'neutral' for them (retarget picks the take's frame closest to the target rest pose), otherwise shoulders/neck get 130-160 deg of twist. Female1's bind is a clean T-pose. Capture floor is not level (hips rise ~6 cm over a 6 m walk): use ground 'plane'.
